conventions.scope: Shared types for Ares behavior parameters. JSON representations are serialization conventions; Python objects require runtime resolution.
conventions.union: A | B accepts either type. Optional[T] means T | null; nullability does not make a parameter optional. Only a constructor default makes it optional.
conventions.containers: list[T], set[T], tuple[T1, T2] and dict[K, V] preserve element types. Units is distinct from list[Unit]. Empty collections are allowed unless a parameter requires otherwise.
conventions.aliases: UnitID = UnitTypeId; np.ndarray = Grid; None = null; typing.List/Set/Tuple/Dict normalize to list/set/tuple/dict; Union[A, B] normalizes to A | B.
conventions.enums: Serialize enum member names, not display names. Valid members come from the installed enum; action-specific allowed values are a separate constraint.
conventions.references: Unit references identify current game entities. Availability, ownership, map bounds and ability compatibility are checked against the current game state.

float.meaning: Finite numeric value; excludes booleans, NaN and infinity.

null.meaning: Python None; valid only when explicitly included in the parameter type.

list[T].meaning: Ordered sequence of T; preserves duplicates.

set[T].meaning: Unique elements of T; order is insignificant. Resolve elements before constructing the set.

tuple[T1, T2].meaning: Exactly two ordered values with the specified positional types.

dict[K, V].meaning: Mapping with typed keys and values. JSON keys are strings; decode integer keys and enum member names to K.

Unit.meaning: Current observation entity ID, resolved to a live Unit; not a unit type or an army count.

Units.meaning: SC2 unit collection constructed from resolved Units with BotAI context; supports SC2 collection methods.

Point2.meaning: Finite map coordinates or a currently available landmark name, resolved to Point2.

Grid.meaning: Reference to a runtime-supplied two-dimensional Ares pathing/influence grid; never an arbitrary model-generated matrix.

UnitTypeId.meaning: Unit or structure type enum, distinct from a live Unit reference.

AbilityId.meaning: Ability enum; the actor must support the selected ability.

UpgradeId.meaning: Research upgrade enum; distinct from UnitTypeId and AbilityId.

UnitRole.meaning: Ares unit-management role enum; valid names come from the local Ares version.

Behavior.meaning: Nested behavior specification requiring construction of a concrete Ares behavior. The type table does not define a nested-action wire format.

CompositionEntry.meaning: Both fields are required. proportion is the desired army fraction; priority is 0..10, with 0 highest.

ArmyComposition.meaning: Unit-type member names map to composition entries. Fractions sum to 1 for proportion-based spawning; SpawnController freeflow_mode ignores proportions.

ResourcePair.meaning: Exactly two resource thresholds in order: minerals, vespene.

TagSet.meaning: Unique SC2 unit tags, distinct from live Unit objects. Group tags must match the resolved group members.

ActionTimes.meaning: Worker tag to last action time in game seconds; mutable Mining bookkeeping supplied by the runtime.
